surface: TUICommander :9876 managed PTY, session input and output
scenario: Send a payload-free notice plus Enter while the CLI is working on sleep 45; then send its immediate-submit key while a second sleep 45 is active.
urgent_delivery_contract: Use Enter only. The CLI presents the queued notice at its next tool boundary. Immediate-submit gestures were measured for a possible separate interrupt feature and are not used for urgent mail.

claude.enter_observation: Press up to edit queued messages; ctrl+enter to send now
claude.enter_effect: Notice reached the model only after the sleep result.
claude.immediate_observation: Bash(sleep 45) -> Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?; notice entered the new turn.
claude.limit: The interrupted shell command did not complete, so the probe proves interruption and notice processing, not continuation of that command.

codex.enter_observation: Messages to be submitted after next tool call (press esc to interrupt and send immediately)
codex.enter_effect: Notice reached the model at a tool boundary; the agent reported reading the inbox before the background sleep completed.
codex.immediate_observation: Model interrupted to submit steer instructions; inbox read occurred while ps still showed sleep 45 at 26 seconds.
codex.limit: The model turn was interrupted; the child sleep process continued and then exited normally.
